verdicts.reason: Both use the same left-to-right banner structure. In both, the lime circle is clipped at the top and bottom edges of the canvas, the NEW VIDEO pill sits under the logo but is not aligned with it, and 'Full review inside.' is so small it is hard to read. A wraps that line onto two lines and jams it against the shoe. B keeps it on one line with cleaner spacing on the right, though its pill floats a little further from the logo. B is marginally the better of the two.
